name: @apps-in-toss/internal-protocol
description: Shared device<->host wire-protocol source for @apps-in-toss/debugger and @apps-in-toss/debugger-client — lives outside packages/ (not a pnpm workspace member, never published). Consumers reach it via tsconfig `paths` + bundler `alias` mapping the `@apps-in-toss/internal-protocol/*` specifier onto `src/*.ts` directly; this manifest is documentation only, not a resolution target. Typecheck/test/lint run through the consumer packages' own tooling (see root package.json's `*:shared` scripts) — this package no longer has its own pnpm scripts (#18, option 4).
